# Bajaj karyana Store — Firozpur

> Premier Confectionery, Kiryana & Daily Grocery Essentials with Doorstep Delivery in Firozpur, Punjab.

## Overview
Bajaj karyana Store is a trusted community grocery and confectionery store established in 1987, situated in Main Market, Firozpur, Punjab (Pincode: 152002). We provide an online ordering platform allowing local residents to browse our extensive inventory of daily grocery staples, premium dry fruits, confectionery, cooking oils, pure desi ghee, pulses, and household cleaning essentials.

## Delivery Policy & Coverage Zone
- **Exclusive Delivery Radius**: Orders are accepted strictly within a **20 km radius** of Firozpur.
- **Eligible Pincodes**:
  - `152001` (Firozpur Cantt)
  - `152002` (Firozpur City / Head Post Office / Main Market)
  - `152003` (Basti Tankawali, Basti Bhattian)
  - `152004` (Kulgarhi, Kasubegu)
  - `152005` (Railway Colony, Basti Machian)
  - `152024` (Ghal Khurd)
  - `152028` (Mudki Border Area)
  - `152116` (Khai Pheme Ki)
  - `152117` (Bazidpur)
- **Delivery Charges**:
  - FREE doorstep delivery on orders above ₹500.
  - Standard flat delivery fee of ₹30 for orders below ₹500.
- **Delivery Time**: Orders placed before 6:00 PM are delivered the same day within 2–4 hours.

## Payment Methods
- **Zero Online Payment Risk**: All orders operate on 100% offline payment upon delivery.
- **Payment Options at Doorstep**:
  - Cash on Delivery (COD)
  - Direct UPI QR Scan (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM) upon delivery

## Product Departments & Categories
1. **Staples & Grains**: Aashirvaad Shudh Chakki Atta, Fortune Atta, Besan (Gram Flour), Maida, Basmati Rice, Sona Masuri Rice, Poha.
2. **Dals & Pulses**: Chana Dal, Toor/Arhar Dal, Moong Dal Yellow, Urad Dal Black, Masoor Dal, Rajma (Chitra), Kabuli Chana (Chole).
3. **Cooking Oils & Ghee**: Amul Pure Desi Ghee, Cow Ghee, Amul Butter, Kachi Ghani Mustard Oil (Sarson), Refined Sunflower Oil, Soyabean Oil.
4. **Spices & Masalas**: Everest, MDH, Catch, and Goldiee Haldi (Turmeric), Lal Mirch (Chilli), Dhaniya (Coriander), Jeera (Cumin), Garam Masala, Elaichi (Cardamom).
5. **Biscuits, Cookies & Bakery**: Parle-G, Britannia Good Day, Marie Gold, Bourbon, Oreo, Rusk, Fresh Bread.
6. **Dry Fruits & Nuts**: California Almonds, Kashmiri Walnuts, Whole Cashews (Kaju), Green Raisins (Kishmish), Festive Gift Boxes.
7. **Beverages & Syrups**: Coca-Cola, Thums Up, Sprite, Maaza, Frooti, Rooh Afza, Red Label CTC Tea, Wagh Bakri Tea, Nescafe Coffee, Bru Coffee.
8. **Personal Care**: Soaps (Dove, Lux, Dettol, Lifebuoy, Pears), Shampoos (Clinic Plus, Dove, Sunsilk, Head & Shoulders), Toothpastes (Colgate, Close-up, Dabur Red, Patanjali Dant Kanti).
9. **Household Cleaning**: Detergents (Surf Excel, Ariel, Tide, Rin), Dishwash (Vim, Exo), Surface & Toilet Cleaners (Lizol, Harpic).
